name: Polar Analytics
description: Polar is the trusted data layer for commerce brands. Connect your Shopify, Meta, Google, Klaviyo, and 45+ other data sources into a unified semantic layer with validated metrics, custom business rules, and cross-platform attribution. Turn Claude into your data analyst. Get answers on ROAS, CAC, top-performing SKUs, profit margins, and more, with answers grounded in consistent, reconciled data instead of raw API pulls. Polar eliminates the "different answer every time" problem by applying your business definitions, exclusions, and attribution logic to every query. Supports multi-store setups and works with major e-commerce integrations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Polar Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Polar Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.polaranalytics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Polar Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Polar Analytics provides these MCP tools: get_context, list_dashboards, get_dashboard_details, list_dimensions, get_dimension_values, get_view_details, get_metrics, get_custom_dimension_details, generate_report, generate_app_report_link, and rate_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Polar Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Polar Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Polar Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Polar Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Polar Analytics is developed by Polar Analytics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
